description: Life given back - the slow green work of keeping everyone standing.

nodes.name: Improved Mark of the Wild
nodes.description: Increases the effect of your Mark of the Wild by 10% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 0, built verbatim: 'Increases the effect of your Mark of the Wild by 10%/20%.' USES _potency because druid_mark_of_the_wild is effect_type 'buff' whose entire content is its stat_mods - _healing or _damage here would be SILENT DEAD DATA, the exact bug that killed Brambles in druid_balance and 99 keys across the project (tools/qa_ability_scoped_fields.py).

nodes.name: Nature's Focus
nodes.description: Reduces the cost of your Healing Touch and Regrowth by 4% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 0: 'Reduces the pushback suffered from damaging attacks while casting your Healing Touch, Regrowth, Nourish, Tranquility and Cyclone spells by 70%.' DEPARTURE - no cast times means NO PUSHBACK to reduce. Being able to keep casting under fire becomes being able to afford it, the same translation used for Fel Concentration and Intensity in the Warlock trees, deliberately, so the pattern is legible rather than ad-hoc. _cost_pct is a FRACTION and POSITIVE IS A REDUCTION.

nodes.name: Furor
nodes.description: Increases your maximum mana by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 0: 'Gives you 20%-100% chance to gain 10 Rage when you shapeshift into Bear Form, or 40 Energy when you shapeshift into Cat Form, and increases your maximum mana by 2%-10%.' SHAPESHIFTING IS NOT A PROC TRIGGER - the twelve triggers are all cast/damage/heal/avoid events and none fires on a form change - so the resource half cannot be built. The mana half is VERBATIM. CRITICAL: max_mana_pct is a FRACTION, measured - 0.20 moved mana 1285 -> 1542, while authoring 20 for '20%' moved it to 26985, a 21x pool. It is the opposite convention to stamina_pct and spirit_pct, which are POINTS.

nodes.name: Naturalist
nodes.description: Increases your physical damage by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 1: 'Reduces the cast time of your Healing Touch by 0.1-0.5 sec and increases the damage you deal with physical attacks by 2%-10%.' No cast times, so only the damage half survives - at its real value. physical_damage is LIVE on the talent bus with 4 read sites.

nodes.name: Subtlety
nodes.description: Reduces the threat your healing generates by 7% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 1, built verbatim: 'Reduces the threat generated by your healing spells by 7%-20%.' threat_multiplier is TALENT-CHANNEL ONLY and would be SILENT DEAD DATA inside a proc's stat_mods - and it is a FRACTION there, while the status channel's threat_generation_pct is POINTS. audit_talents caught that exact mix-up in Shadowstep this session.

nodes.name: Natural Shapeshifter
nodes.description: Reduces the cost of your shapeshifting by 10% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 1, built verbatim: 'Reduces the mana cost of all shapeshifting by 10%/20%/30%.' ALL FIVE FORMS CARRY A REAL COST (bear 20, cat 25, moonkin 30, tree 35, dire bear 30), which was CHECKED rather than assumed - the Warlock's Master Summoner node was authored the same way and ALL FOUR of its keys were dead because summons are free.

nodes.name: Intensity
nodes.description: Restores 5 mana every 5 seconds per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 2: 'Allows 17%-50% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.' DEPARTURE - there is no casting/not-casting distinction without cast times, so regen-while-casting becomes plain regen. mp5 is FLAT and measured LIVE (mp5=5 moved the attribute +5); there is no mp5-from-Spirit conversion, because STAT_CONVERSION_TARGETS has no mana or regen target at all.

nodes.name: Omen of Clarity
nodes.description: Your heals sometimes cost you nothing at all.
nodes._source: WotLK row 2: 'Your damage and healing spells have a chance to cause your next damage or healing spell to be cast without consuming mana.' DEPARTURE - THERE IS NO NEXT-CAST-MODIFIER MECHANIC (no cast counter, no streak, no accumulator of any kind), so a free next cast is not expressible. Refunding the mana directly is the same outcome by a route the engine has. grant_resource takes a FLAT amount - there is no pct_max - and 70 is roughly one Regrowth, so it reads as 'that one was free'. Druid resource confirmed MANA before authoring, per the standing check-the-resource-first rule.

nodes.name: Master Shapeshifter
nodes.description: In Tree of Life form, increases your healing by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 2: 'Grants an effect which lasts while you are within the respective shapeshift form - Bear: 4% physical damage, Cat: 4% crit, Moonkin: 4% spell damage, Tree of Life: 4% healing.' ONLY THE TREE BRANCH IS BUILT, because require_form gates the WHOLE NODE and there is no way to give one node four different payloads by form. Tree is the right branch for the Restoration tree, and the node sits below the Tree of Life unlock's own branch. healing_done is TALENT-CHANNEL ONLY (abilities.py:1585); the status channel's equivalent is healing_done_pct in POINTS.

nodes.name: Tranquil Spirit
nodes.description: Reduces the cost of your Healing Touch by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 3, built verbatim for the spell we have: 'Reduces the mana cost of your Healing Touch, Nourish and Tranquility spells by 2%-10%.' Nourish and Tranquility do not exist. Stacks with Nature's Focus, as the real pair does.

nodes.name: Improved Rejuvenation
nodes.description: Increases the healing of your Rejuvenation by 5% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 3, built verbatim: 'Increases the effect of your Rejuvenation spell by 5%/10%/15%.' USES _healing: druid_rejuvenation is effect_type 'hot', so _healing is read (abilities.py:1584, inside the school == 'healing' branch). NOT _potency - the outgoing tree's Gift of the Earthmother used ability_druid_rejuvenation_potency and it was DEAD, because rejuvenation carries no stat_mods for potency to scale.

nodes.name: Nature's Swiftness
nodes.description: Teaches Nature's Swiftness, one heal that will not wait.
nodes._source: WotLK row 4 - MOVED FROM TIER 6 to its real tier 2. The ONLY unlock for druid_natures_swiftness, which is requires_talent.

nodes.name: Gift of Nature
nodes.description: Increases all your healing by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 4, built verbatim: 'Increases the effect of all healing spells by 2%-10%.' The tree's backbone throughput talent. Improved Tranquility, the other row-4 talent, is DROPPED - no Tranquility ability exists.

nodes.name: Empowered Touch
nodes.description: Increases the healing of your Healing Touch by 10% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 5: 'Your Healing Touch and Nourish spells gain an additional 20%/40% of your bonus healing effects.' Spell-power coefficients are not exposed to talents, so it becomes direct healing. druid_healing_touch is effect_type 'heal', so _healing lands - and NOT _crit, which the outgoing tree used on this very ability and which was dead, because HEALS NEVER ROLL CRIT in this engine.

nodes.name: Nature's Bounty
nodes.description: Increases the critical strike chance of your Regrowth, Healing Touch and Swiftmend by 5% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 5: 'Increases the critical strike chance of your Regrowth, Healing Touch, Nourish and Swiftmend spells by 5%-25%.' BUILT VERBATIM, and it only became buildable TODAY. Until 5 Nov 2026 heals never rolled crit in this engine - _roll_crit was called from the four DAMAGE branches and nowhere in the healing path - so the outgoing tree's ability_druid_healing_touch_crit and ability_druid_swiftmend_crit were SILENT DEAD DATA, found by tools/qa_ability_scoped_fields.py. An interim version of this node was rebuilt on _healing to work around it. Then Kyle said 'spells should be able to crit!' and healing crits were added to combat/abilities.py, so the real talent is now authorable as written and the workaround is reverted. ability_<id>_crit is PERCENTAGE POINTS and feeds crit_chance_spell, which is the stat the new healing crit roll reads. Nourish does not exist.

nodes.name: Living Spirit
nodes.description: Increases your total Spirit by 5% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 6, built verbatim: 'Increases your total Spirit by 5%/10%/15%.' THE TREE'S KEYSTONE STAT TALENT, and it is built on Spirit on purpose - Kyle, 5 Nov: 'resto druid does really well with spirit gear' and 'i love spirit'. spirit_pct is PERCENTAGE POINTS (read off `bonuses` at character.py:1263 and divided by 100), which is why a literal read-site probe finds nothing and the key is nonetheless LIVE - measured: spirit_pct=20 moved healing power 23 -> 25. It pairs directly with Improved Tree of Life below, which turns that Spirit into healing power.

nodes.name: Swiftmend
nodes.description: Teaches Swiftmend, spending a heal-over-time all at once.
nodes._source: WotLK row 6 - MOVED FROM TIER 2 to its real tier 4. The ONLY unlock for druid_swiftmend, which is requires_talent.

nodes.name: Natural Perfection
nodes.description: Reduces the damage you take by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 6: 'Reduces the chance you'll be critically hit by 4%-12% and your spell damage taken is reduced by 1%-3% after being the victim of a critical strike.' BOTH CLAUSES BLOCKED: crit_taken_reduction IS A DEAD TALENT KEY (measured, and replaced in sun_cleric_blessings, warlock_demonology and druid_feral this session), and there is NO ON-CRIT-TAKEN TRIGGER - the twelve proc triggers include on_damage_taken but nothing that fires only on a critical hit against you. So it becomes flat mitigation. BARE damage_taken_pct is read RAW ON BOTH SIDES, so -0.02 is 2%.

nodes.name: Empowered Rejuvenation
nodes.description: Increases the healing of your heal-over-time spells by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 7: 'The bonus healing effects of your heal-over-time spells is increased by 4%-20%.' Built on the three hots by name rather than a global key, because there is no hot-specific healing MAGNITUDE key - hot_duration_pct is a duration, and Genesis in druid_balance had to fall back to the much broader healing_done for the same reason. All three are effect_type 'hot', so _healing lands on each.

nodes.name: Living Seed
nodes.description: Your critical heals plant a seed that blooms into more healing.
nodes._source: WotLK row 7: 'When you critically heal your target with Regrowth, Healing Touch or Nourish you plant a Living Seed on the target for 30% of the amount healed.' BUILT WITH ITS REAL ON_CRIT TRIGGER, which only became possible on 5 Nov 2026. The whole premise of this talent is a CRITICAL HEAL, and heals could not crit in this engine until then - an interim version rode on_heal_cast at a 15% chance as a workaround. The healing crit change sets self._last_crit in the heal branch exactly as the damage branches do, which is what makes ProcTrigger.ON_CRIT fire from a heal, so this is now the real talent. 100% chance is correct and legitimate on a multi-rank node ONLY because the crit itself is the gate - but note the payload does not scale with points, so ranks buy reliability of access rather than size. smart_heal_pct reads the triggering heal's amount, one of only three payloads that read the trigger's value, so the seed genuinely scales with the crit that planted it.

nodes.name: Revitalize
nodes.description: Your heal-over-time spells return mana to you.
nodes._source: WotLK row 8: 'Your Rejuvenation and Wild Growth ticks have a 5%-15% chance to restore 8 energy, 4 rage, 1% mana or 16 runic power to the target.' DEPARTURE - A DOT OR HOT TICK IS NOT A TRIGGER (the twelve triggers are cast, damage, heal, kill and avoidance events; nothing fires per tick), so it rides the CAST of those two spells instead. The resource goes to the DRUID rather than the target, because a talent effect can never reach an ally. grant_resource is a FLAT amount - there is no pct_max - so the real 1% is not expressible. ability_filter is validated by the kit against the real ability list.

nodes.name: Tree of Life
nodes.description: Teaches Tree of Life form, rooted and giving.
nodes._source: WotLK row 8 - MOVED FROM TIER 3 to its real tier 5. The ONLY unlock for druid_tree_of_life, which is requires_talent - a gate set earlier this session, when all five druid forms turned out to be auto-learned and the talent points spent on them bought nothing at all.

nodes.name: Improved Tree of Life
nodes.description: In Tree of Life form, you gain healing power equal to 10% of your Spirit per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 8: 'Increases your armor while in Tree of Life Form by 67%-200%, and increases your healing spells by 5%-15% of your Spirit.' THE SPIRIT HALF IS THE POINT OF THIS NODE and is built verbatim at 10% per rank - Kyle, 5 Nov: 'resto druid does really well with spirit gear'. It is the direct payoff for Living Spirit two tiers down: that node grows Spirit, this one turns Spirit into healing power. MEASURED: healing_power_from_spirit_pct=0.5 moved healing power 23 -> 50. RAW MULTIPLIER convention (gained = source * pct, character.py:1551), so 0.10 and never 10. spirit is a valid conversion SOURCE and healing_power a valid TARGET. The armour half is dropped - a tree-form armour bonus is real but this node already does one clear thing.

nodes.name: Improved Barkskin
nodes.description: Increases the effect of your Barkskin by 15% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 9: 'Increases the damage reduction granted by your Barkskin spell by 5%/10%, and reduces the chance you'll be critically hit by melee attacks by 2%/4%.' USES _potency because druid_barkskin is effect_type 'buff' whose content is its stat_mods - CHECKED, it really does carry them. The crit-taken half is dropped: crit_taken_reduction is a DEAD talent key.

nodes.name: Gift of the Earthmother
nodes.description: Increases your haste by 1% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 9: 'Increases your spell haste by 2%-10% and your Rejuvenation instantly heals for an additional amount.' The haste half is built at 1% per rank; haste is POINTS and was MEASURED (haste=5 moved the attribute 9 -> 14). THE OUTGOING TREE'S VERSION OF THIS NODE WAS DEAD: it used ability_druid_rejuvenation_potency, and rejuvenation carries no stat_mods at all, so there was no potency to scale. The instant-heal clause is dropped rather than rebuilt as _healing, because Improved Rejuvenation and Empowered Rejuvenation already buff that spell and a third node doing it would read as the same talent printed three times.

nodes.name: Wild Growth
nodes.description: Teaches Wild Growth, healing the whole party at once.
nodes._source: WotLK row 10, the capstone - MOVED FROM TIER 4 to its real tier 6. The ONLY unlock for druid_wild_growth, which is requires_talent. Every one of this tree's four unlocks was at the wrong tier before this rebuild.

nodes.name: Wild Abundance
nodes.description: Increases the critical strike damage of your spells by 20% per rank.
nodes._source: Authored 6 Nov. Kyle: 'all caster classes should have a 5 point talent that increases their spell crit damage by 100%.' Mirrors priest_shadow's Shadow Power and shaman_elemental's Elemental Fury, both of which are WoW-accurate at 5 x 20%. Placed on tier 4 beside the existing tier-4 block; connected_to is cosmetic (it draws the edge), spending is gated by tier_requirements.
